en.t: At last, he had no choice but to rise and take his leave.

units.source_text: 走了几步，回头一看，但见这个一向羞涩不前的人，居然走出门来送别了。

en.t: After walking a few steps, he looked back and saw that this person, who had always been too shy to come forward, had actually come out through the door to see him off.

units.source_text: 明石姬举目一望，觉得这真是一个相貌堂堂的美男子！

en.t: When Lady Akashi raised her eyes and looked at him, she thought he truly was a handsome man of noble bearing.

units.source_text: 他的身体本来瘦长，现在略胖了些，便更加匀称了。

en.t: His figure had originally been tall and slender, but now that he had filled out a little, it seemed even better proportioned.

units.source_text: 服装也都称体，十足具有内大臣的风度，连裙裾上也泛溢出风流高雅的气息来。

en.t: His clothes suited him perfectly, giving him all the dignity of a Minister of the Interior, and even the hem of his robe seemed to overflow with an air of refined elegance.

units.source_text: 这也未免有点情人眼里出西施吧。

en.t: Perhaps this was, after all, a little like seeing beauty through a lover's eyes.
